segments.ja231:1.1: Yathāpi kītā purisassupāhanā, sukhassa atthāya dukhaṃ udabbahe;
segments.ja231:1.3: Ghammābhitattā thalasā papīḷitā, tasseva pāde purisassa khādare.
segments.ja231:2.1: Evameva yo dukkulīno anariyo, tammāka [tamhāka (sī.), tumhāka (syā. pī.)] vijjañca sutañca ādiya;
segments.ja231:2.3: Tameva so tattha sutena khādati, anariyo vuccati dupāhanūpamoti [pānadūpamoti (sī. pī.)].
